**ID:** X1000
**Volume:** X58
**Category:** 華嚴部類

**Byline:** 宋 希迪錄

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This one-fascicle text is [希迪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%8C%E8%BF%AA) Xīdí's polemical response to [師會](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%9C%83) Shīhuì's *[Fù gǔ jì 復古記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0078)* (X998) and, by extension, to Shīhuì's earlier *[Fén xīn 焚薪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0076)* (X996). The alternative title *Fú fén xīn* 扶焚薪 ("In Defence Against the *Fén xīn*") makes explicit the polemical positioning: where Shīhuì had "burnt the firewood" of [道亭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%93%E4%BA%AD) Dàotíng's earlier readings, Xīdí here "supports / defends" against Shīhuì's own polemic.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to the period after Xīdí's *[Jí chéng jì 集成記](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0079)* of 1218 — i.e. to roughly the period 1218 – 1230 CE — when Xīdí, having established his synthetic reading of the *Wǔ jiào zhāng* 五教章 in the *Jí chéng jì*, turned to engage the rival Shīhuì commentary tradition critically. The bracket adopted here reflects this window. The work completes the cycle of Sòng *Wǔ jiào zhāng* commentary literature: Dàotíng → Shīhuì (*Fén xīn* and *Fù gǔ jì*) → Xīdí (*Jí chéng jì* and *Píng fù gǔ jì*) — five major commentaries in 130 years on a single 4-fascicle treatise, the most intensively studied work in Sòng Huáyán-school scholarship.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* 續藏經 (X1000) collection.
